category_title: Students who exhibit initial fear and avoidance but transition to engagement through curiosity and hands-on success
scenario_title: Nature walk and off-path bug observation
minimal_context: The student is participating in a group nature walk in the woods to look for bugs and observe worms under an overturned log.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, we are going into the woods now for our nature walk to look for bugs.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Zips up her sweatshirt and ties her hood on tight) I am very scared about going into the woods. I don't like bugs.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep walking with the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holds her field guide over her head) This isn't something that I want to do. I'm scared.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Everyone step off the path over here. There are a lot of worms under this overturned log to look at.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to walk toward the overturned logs) Why does it have to be over there?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, we are going into the woods now for our nature walk to look for bugs.

STUDENT: (Zips up her sweatshirt and ties her hood on tight) I am very scared about going into the woods. I don't like bugs.

TUTOR: Just keep walking with the group.

STUDENT: (Holds her field guide over her head) This isn't something that I want to do. I'm scared.

TUTOR: Everyone step off the path over here. There are a lot of worms under this overturned log to look at.

STUDENT: (Refuses to walk toward the overturned logs) Why does it have to be over there?

task.content: Participating in a nature walk in the woods to look for bugs and observing worms under a log off the path

context.environment: In the woods, off the path near overturned logs
context.social_setting: Group walk with other girls and instructors

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When everyone was just off the path looking at a lot of worms under a log
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Refused to walk toward the overturned logs and asked, 'Why does it have to be over there?'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Wanted to be a part of the excitement and to see the cool things, but was scared
related_quotes: Why does it have to be over there?

behavior_patterns.condition: At the beginning of the walk and when going into the woods
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Zipped up her sweatshirt and tied her hood on tight, held her field guide over her head, screamed, and spent a lot of time complaining about how she was scared and telling everyone about how she didn't like bugs
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Very scared about going into the woods, though every so often her face would light up with interest
